prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" health insurance broker for everyone in Kansas City; the right choice depends on whether you need individual/family coverage, Medicare guidance, or small business/group benefits.
Several top-rated, independent local agencies and brokers operate in the Kansas City metro area:
Focus: Individual and family marketplace/private plans, subsidy checks, and group health.
Locations: North Kansas City, MO; Lawson, MO; Overland Park, KS (serves both MO and KS).
Details: BBB A+ accredited with a 5.0 Google rating; broker services are free of charge to the client.
Contact: (816) 205-4664
Focus: Medicare (Initial Enrollment, Advantage, Part D) and Marketplace plans.
Details: Operating since 1993; Marketplace Elite Circle of Champions.
Contact: (816) 436-2622 Jeff David Insurance
Focus: Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, life insurance, and fixed-annuity products.
Locations: Northland (Kansas City, MO) and Lee's Summit, MO.
Contact: (816) 925-2368
HUB International (Kansas City / Overland Park) — Handles custom commercial and employee health insurance plans for local businesses.
Mylo / USI Insurance Services — Mid-size to large employer health, medical, and retirement benefits in the Overland Park and KC area. HUB International +1
Cost: Independent health insurance brokers are free to use—they are compensated directly by the insurance carriers, and your plan rates do not go up by using one. BBS Insurance Inc. +1
Licensing: Ensure the broker is licensed in both Kansas and Missouri if you live on one side of the state line and see doctors or hospitals on the other.
Direct Carriers: If you are specifically looking at regional network options like Blue KC, you can also work directly with their customer or advisory team alongside independent brokers. Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Kansas City
